title: Young Girl Standing by Sapling Tree, 1950s Suburban B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square black-and-white snapshot featuring a young girl smiling as she holds onto a staked sapling tree planted in a front yard lawn. She is wearing a dark top, a light-colored skirt with flap pockets, and short socks. Behind her, a paved suburban street separates the lawn from mid-century single-story ranch homes with wide windows and manicured yards, evoking post-WWII American suburban growth and peaceful domestic life during the 1950s.
